Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Bănci și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About Us: 
 20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles . 
 What you’ll find here: 
Digital transformation projects with real impact
A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are currently looking for experienced professionals to deliver high-quality, stable, and resilient software solutions.
 We are currently looking for a curious, proactive, friendly and analytical iOS Developer to join big, diverse, and well-knit team of coders who love not only developing applications but also challenges, hiking, and smart ideas.
 TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED 
 Must Have: 
Proficiency in IoS/SwiftUI development, with past projects available to demonstrate this proficiency.
Knowledge of mobile landscape, architectures, trends, and emerging technologies (e.g., KMP).
Excellent understanding of RESTful APIs.
Understand complex business and functional requirements and produce technical specifications.
Experience with Firebase services (Cloud Messaging, Deep Links, Crashlytics, etc.) is a plus.
Good understanding of UX/UI concepts for mobile devices.
Experience with integration of 3rd party SDKs and services (e.g. camera, document scanning, electronic signature)
Experience with monitoring and logging solutions (e.g. Firebase, Crashlytics)
Experience with Azure DevOps and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
Familiarity with agile development concepts (SCRUM).
Fluent in English
 Nice to Have: 
Experience with other mobile development platforms
Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, Ruby, etc.)
Continuous Integration, Jenkins
SwiftUI / Combine / other Reactive frameworks.
 *Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
